Row.Text: A republic of wool merchants and bankers on the Arno, which spent two centuries of profit on painters, architects and the recovery of the ancient world.
Build a Bottega and a Banco in the same District to form the Piazza. The Piazza is what makes the Maestro available: train them, and retire them where their gift will do most good.
Lorenzo de' Medici, who held no office and ruled Florence for twenty-three years.
